summary: Verified fix-pack 1 remnants for Chez Dina. Backend: POST /api/pages enforces slug uniqueness (409) for duplicate and seeded 'about' slug; new unique slug returns 200. Frontend: logged in as admin, cycled through all 13 Dashboard period presets (today, yesterday, this_week, last_week, last7, last30, this_month, last_month, this_quarter, last_quarter, this_year, last_year, all) with ZERO 'Cannot read properties of undefined' errors AND zero 'NaN' strings in DOM. KPI cards 'CA période' (9,9 M FCFA / title 9 925 500 FCFA), 'Panier moyen' (91,1 k FCFA / title 91 059 FCFA), 'Marge brute' (5 M FCFA / title 5 004 375 FCFA) all show compact format + native title tooltip. TAUX D'ANNULATION now displays '-14.3%' (NaN bug from iteration_22 resolved). Statistiques: all 12 tabs (sales, products, categories, stock-purchases, orders-delivery, zones, customers, demand, marketing, site, encaissements, team) load on multiple periods without TypeError. Orders view switcher exposes data-testid='orders-view-table' and 'orders-view-kanban' (both found). Regression on /livraisons, /marques, /fournisseurs, /liste-attente, /manuel, /finances, /settings all clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Guards (`|| []`) added across Dashboard/Statistiques are correct short-term fixes; long-term the backend should return normalized shapes via Pydantic defaults so defensive code isn't repeated per-callsite.
fcfaCompact + title attribute pattern is good UX; consider wrapping in a reusable <Money compact /> component to avoid repeating the title plumbing everywhere.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 13/13 period presets, 12/12 stats tabs, 7/7 regression pages

seed_data_creation: One ephemeral cms_pages row created per test run with random slug test-<uuid>; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard period testids now exist: [data-testid='period-selector'] opens menu with [data-testid='period-{key}'] for keys today/yesterday/this_week/last_week/last7/last30/this_month/last_month/this_quarter/last_quarter/this_year/last_year/all/custom. Stats tab testids: [data-testid='stats-tab-{sales|products|categories|stock-purchases|orders-delivery|zones|customers|demand|marketing|site|encaissements|team}']. KPICard renders .valueFull via `title` attribute (native tooltip). NaN bug on Taux d'annulation from iter_22 is fixed. No hydration <span> inside <option> warning observed in this run.
